result.description: Mansys Pty Ltd   Electrical Engineering Technician    Employer:  Integra Switchboards Pty Ltd   Location:  Brendale, Queensland 4500   Position:  Full-time   Salary:  AUD 80,000 to A$90,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience       Integra Switchboards Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and experienced Electrical Engineering Technician to join their team in Brendale, Queensland. The successful candidate will support the design, manufacture, testing, commissioning and quality checking of low-voltage electrical switchboards, distribution boards, motor control centres and control panels.  This role is suited to a technically competent person with experience in electrical systems, switchboard manufacture, testing procedures, technical drawings, electrical components and Australian electrical standards.   Key duties and responsibilities   The Electrical Engineering Technician will be responsible for:   Assisting Electrical Engineers, project managers and senior technical staff with the design and layout of electrical switchboards, distribution boards, motor control centres, control panels, cabling arrangements and associated electrical systems.  Preparing, interpreting and reviewing technical drawings, wiring diagrams, layout drawings, schematics and electrical plans for switchboard manufacturing projects.  Conducting tests on electrical systems, components and switchboard assemblies to confirm operational performance, safety and compliance with project specifications.  Collecting technical data, recording test results, performing calculations, preparing test documentation, charts, reports and tabulations for engineering and quality assurance purposes.  Assisting with estimating material requirements, component quantities, labour requirements and project costs for switchboard and electrical assembly works.  Inspecting designs, manufactured switchboards and completed electrical assemblies to ensure compliance with specifications, Australian Standards, client requirements and safety requirements.  Assembling, installing, testing, calibrating, modifying and repairing electrical equipment, switchboard components, protection devices, metering equipment, indicating devices and control equipment.  Supporting workshop electrical functions, including installation of assemblies for protection relays, metering devices, control circuits and electrical indicating equipment.  Assisting with fault finding, technical problem solving and rectification of electrical issues during manufacture, testing and commissioning.  Liaising with internal design, fabrication, assembly and project teams to ensure switchboards are delivered accurately, safely and on time.  Maintaining accurate technical records, testing records, compliance documents and quality assurance documentation.  Ensuring all work is performed in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements, company procedures, project specifications and relevant Australian Standards.    Skills and experience required   Applicants must have:   Diploma or Bachelors in Electrical Engineering or related field  Atleast 2 years of experience in electrical switchboard manufacture, electrical systems, control panels, distribution boards, motor control centres or similar electrical engineering environments.  Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics and technical specifications.  Experience conducting electrical tests, recording results and assisting with technical reporting.  Knowledge of electrical components such as circuit breakers, busbars, contactors, relays, metering equipment, control devices, terminals and cabling systems.    Skills Required    Good technical problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.  Ability to work safely and effectively in a workshop/manufacturing environment.  Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a technical project team.      Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Working as part of a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure that support critical business outcomes.   This role is based in Brisbane and requires a commitment to working onsite 4-5 days per week. Due to the nature of the environment, this position cannot be performed remotely. Brisbane-based candidates are strongly preferred, however applications are welcomed from interstate candidates who are genuinely committed to relocating. Joining a collaborative engineering team, you will contribute to the delivery and sustainment of modern software development platforms, automation capabilities and secure infrastructure supporting critical business outcomes.  An NV2 Security Clearance is highly desirable. We also encourage applications from candidates who hold NV1 or Baseline clearances, or Australian Citizens who are eligible and willing to obtain a security clearance. 
   Your new role     
 As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, implementation and ongoing support of secure software development environments and CI/CD pipelines. Working alongside engineering, infrastructure and security teams, you will help drive automation, improve platform performance and ensure development environments remain secure, scalable and compliant.   
  Key responsibilities:   
 
 Designing, implementing and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines

  Key requirements:  
 
 CI/CD pipeline design, implementation and support

 Kubernetes and Docker environments

 Linux administration, particularly Ubuntu and Red Hat 
 Secure software development environments and DevSecOps practices 
 Technical troubleshooting and performance optimisation 
 Documentation, change management and governance processes 
 
  Highly desirable:  
 
 Defence, government or other highly regulated environments

  What you'll get in return

MYAC Resources is currently seeking an experienced Truck Driver / Yard Person on behalf of our client, a well-established engineering and fabrication company based in Perth, Western Australia.
Our client is looking for a reliable and hands-on person for an immediate start. The successful candidate will take ownership of the yard while supporting the day-to-day operations of a busy fabrication workshop. This is a varied role involving truck driving, forklift operation, yard management and general trade-assistant duties.
About the role
As a Truck Driver/Yard Person you will support our workshop to ensure we deliver a quality product to our client, in full and on time.  
This will include:
Your responsibilities will include:
•	Providing support to the team as required to complete work activities
•	Performing daily pre-start checklist on vehicles to ensure they are fit for operations
•	Using the Forklift to move steel and equipment around the yard
•	Ensuring deliveries and collections are completed safely and on time
•	Loading and unloading trucks and delivery vehicles
•	Operating a variety of tools including grinders, power drills and other cutting or shaping tools as required to complete assigned tasks
•	Ability to take ownership of the Yard
About you
To be considered for this position, you must have:
•	A current and valid HR driver’s licence
•	A current forklift licence
•	Previous truck-driving experience
•	A positive, can-do attitude
•	A strong focus on safety and quality
•	The ability to work independently and as part of a team
•	The physical ability to undertake manual and hands-on work
•	Previous experience within an engineering, fabrication, mining or industrial workshop will be highly regarded.
What’s on offer
•	Full-time, ongoing employment
•	Competitive hourly rate based on experience
•	Immediate start available
•	A varied, hands-on position
•	A supportive and practical workshop team
•	Opportunity to grow with an established engineering and fabrication business

result.description:
Who We Are
We're a proud Tasmanian family-owned business with over a century of experience in general engineering. Our modern fabrication and machining workshops are located just 10 minutes south of Hobart in Kingston. We specialise in the manufacture, repair, refurbishment, installation, and maintenance of industrial equipment.

The Opportunity
We're on the lookout for skilled Boilermaker Welders to join our dynamic team. Our workshop operations cover a wide range of fabrication and welding tasks, from light to heavy work with steel, stainless steel and aluminium components. You'll work from engineering drawings and use equipment such as CNC plasma cutters, plate rolls, brake presses, bandsaws, and various welding techniques such as MIG, TIG and stick.

What You'll Do
Operate equipment such as plate rolls, rotators, bandsaws, presses and overhead cranes.
Use a variety of welding equipment including MIG, TIG, and stick.
Fabricate steel, aluminium, and stainless-steel components and assemblies.
Carryout repairs on plant and equipment.
Perform welding tasks that range from basic general-purpose applications to coded welding on quality-critical components and equipment.

Why Join Us?
At Saunders & Ward, we offer:
The option to work a 4-day week.
Excellent working conditions.
Stable employment with a well-established, family-owned company.
A diverse range of stimulating work.
Modern, well-organised and clean workshops.
A friendly, safety-focused culture.
Regular overtime.
A graded pay structure that rewards skills and experience.
Annual performance and wage reviews.
Rostered days off (RDOs).

What We're Looking For
To be successful in this role, you should have:
A strong commitment to safe work practices.
A fabrication trade qualification.
Engineering workshop experience.
Experience with mild steel MIG welding and fabrication.
The ability to complete jobs on time and to quality standards.
The ability to pass drug and alcohol screening.

If you're ready to bring your skills and experience to a great team, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your cover letter and resume to our Fabrication Manager, Matt Brown, via our online application.
